scope: Dedicated light-sampling-1 actual two user pixels only, mode3 diagnostic; not a runtime proposal table
layout: 3925x1 little-endian RGBA32I: 2 header records per receiver then sorted x,y,z,material light records; position header xyz float32 bits, w octSnorm2x16 normal bits
receiver_validation: Actual material, origin within .005 world units, normal cosine >.999, and exact emitter count; host must additionally verify full leaf/mass/topology and voxel identities
output: RGB conditional linear-sRGB Z_l with lightPdf=1; alpha dot(Z_l,Z_l), the summed RGB second moment. Retain zero outcomes. Flatten index: light=index%N, point=(index//N)%2, samples=floor(width*height/(2*N)); trailing pixels zero.
audit: First2 records: origin/material; normal/per-frame conditional samples; albedo/receiver-valid; rawpixel xy/lightcount/mode3. Compare actual origins/normals/albedo to primary sampling inputs.
acceptance: Full current light and nonemissive input identity before/after, receiver validation, common complete raw samples, nonfinite counts, two disjoint windows. Infer sum(M2/q)-norm(sum(mean))^2, not mathematical convergence or measured whole-ROI error.
